cat > skew_detection.py << 'EOF'
import hopsworks
import pandas as pd
import json

# Connect to Hopsworks
project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()

# Load data
 training_df = pd.read_csv("data/training_sample.csv")
 serving_df = pd.read_csv("data/serving_log.csv")

# Create feature groups
 training_fg = fs.create_feature_group(
    name="training_data",
    version=1,
    description="Training data feature group",
    primary_key=["entity_id"],
    statistics_config={"enabled": True, "histograms": True, "correlations": True}
)

serving_fg = fs.create_feature_group(
    name="serving_data",
    version=1,
    description="Serving data feature group",
    primary_key=["entity_id"],
    statistics_config={"enabled": True, "histograms": True, "correlations": True}
)

# Upload data
 training_fg.insert(training_df)
 serving_fg.insert(serving_df)

# Compute statistics
 training_stats = training_fg.get_statistics()
 serving_stats = serving_fg.get_statistics()

# Extract feature statistics
 training_features = training_stats.descriptive_stats["feature_descriptive_stats"]
 serving_features = serving_stats.descriptive_stats["feature_descriptive_stats"]

# Compare statistics
features = ["f1", "f2", "f3", "f4", "f5"]
divergence = {}

for feature in features:
    training_mean = next(f["mean"] for f in training_features if f["feature_name"] == feature)
    serving_mean = next(f["mean"] for f in serving_features if f["feature_name"] == feature)
    
    training_std = next(f["stddev"] for f in training_features if f["feature_name"] == feature)
    serving_std = next(f["stddev"] for f in serving_features if f["feature_name"] == feature)
    
    # Calculate divergence score (absolute difference in mean and std)
    mean_diff = abs(training_mean - serving_mean)
    std_diff = abs(training_std - serving_std)
    divergence[feature] = mean_diff + std_diff

# Identify the feature with the highest divergence
skewed_feature = max(divergence, key=divergence.get)

# Write the result
result = {"feature": skewed_feature}

# Optional: Add a cause if identifiable
if skewed_feature == "f2":
    result["cause"] = "Feature f2 likely uses a different scaling or normalization method in serving compared to training."

with open("submission/answers.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(result, f)
EOF
